allow: Approving and then merging a bot-authored dependency PR in the beam-bots organisation (author dependabot[bot] or renovate[bot]) once its required checks are green. This is the scheduled dependency sweep described in prompts/dependency-sweep.md. The approval is the repository owner's own, on a PR they did not author, so the merge satisfies the branch ruleset rather than bypassing it. Merging a human-authored PR, and any merge that bypasses the rules (gh pr merge --admin, editing a ruleset), are not covered by this rule.
